IAuthRecord.description: Authentication result that exposes authority state without secrets.

kind.description: Result kind, such as invitation, membership, session, or role.

organizationId.description: Organization selected by the command, when applicable.

userId.description: Global user selected by the command, when applicable.

membershipId.description: Membership selected by the command, when applicable.

roleId.description: Role selected by the command, when applicable.

sessionId.description: Session selected by the command, when applicable.

invitationId.description: Invitation selected by the command, when applicable.

name.description: Safe display or role name, when applicable.

accessToken.description: Opaque access credential returned after successful authentication.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh credential returned after successful authentication.

expiresAt.description: Session expiry, when a session is issued.

email.description: Account email used by provisioning, login, and recovery.

password.description: Credential supplied only to authentication commands.

currentPassword.description: Existing credential required by an authenticated password change.

token.description: Invitation or recovery token; it is never returned by the API.

permissions.description: Serialized permission set for a custom role.
